scope: read-only source/sampler audit plus bounded import/process-pool diagnostics; no SOLWEIG numerical workload rerun

outcome.measurement_class: correctness admission diagnostic; not benchmark timing

sampler_audit.behavior: The outer runner launches one child, then sums RSS for that child and child.children(recursive=True). The outer runner/monitor is not in members. It kills the child process group above 12 GiB.
sampler_audit.limitation: Original samples recorded only totals, not PIDs. Attribution is established by the matching bounded reproduction and source control flow.

bounded_phases.finding: Torch import, CUDA initialization/tensor synchronization, and upstream package import each remain below 0.76 GB summed RSS and complete with one process.

pool_probe.interpretation: After CUDA/upstream import, ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=32) forks all 32 workers on first submission. Shared inherited pages are charged once per worker by the frozen summed-RSS metric, reproducing the cap failure.

upstream_source.control_flow: thermal_comfort preprocesses, calls run_walls_aspect, then calculate_svf and run_utci_tiles. On Linux run_walls_aspect chooses min(32, os.cpu_count()) without bounding by len(args_list); the small fixture has one tile, but first submit starts 32 fork workers.

finding.root_cause: Legitimate original-upstream wall/aspect orchestration under the public workflow, specifically 32 forked workers inheriting the CUDA-initialized process image. This is not duplicate Torch import in the harness, an unrelated process, or a sampler ancestry bug.
finding.rss_gate_interpretation: The majority is shared memory: at the probe peak RSS=14.170 GB, PSS=0.741 GB, USS=0.318 GB. This explains the metric but does not waive the frozen summed-RSS cap.
finding.admission: Original upstream CUDA public first-use/cold remains resource-failed under the 12 GiB summed-RSS policy.

interventions_for_review.proposal: In run_parallel, set max_workers=max(1,min(platform_limit,cpu_count,len(args_list))) so a one-tile fixture starts one worker.
interventions_for_review.workload_effect: Does not change tiles, physics, resolution, timesteps, outputs, or per-tile numerical function; changes orchestration and must be labeled patched upstream, then rerun correctness admission.

interventions_for_review.proposal: Use the public run_utci_tiles entrypoint on hash-verified prepared geometry, as already defined for the geometry-warm regime.
interventions_for_review.boundary: Cannot replace first-use or geometry-cold public thermal_comfort admission.

prohibited_conclusion: Do not raise/disable the cap, relabel summed RSS as PSS, or count CUDA as passed from this diagnostic.
